comparison: Original PMX face material directly versus final v13 actual PRINT STL

area_samples.weighting: Each triangle contributes its exact area divided among its deterministic samples; region medians/p95 are area-weighted, maxima are sampled.

reverse_scope.gate: Current Y<-6,Z<=45,|X|<=26. Actual triangle centroid must be frontmost along+Y within0.01mm and original PMX material must occupy that XZ ray. Nearest original face normal dot current normal>=.25; source-coordinate region membership; no distance cutoff. Thus new fill in original holes and internal cavity/neck returns are excluded; their mismatches are not mislabeled facial skin.

nose_tip.meaning: Closest final surface point to original extremum; not a semantically matched final landmark.

chin_bottom.meaning: Closest final surface point to original extremum; not a semantically matched final landmark.

original_mouth_boundary.meaning: Distance to nearest final skin, not to corresponding final aperture edge. Actual eye aperture outline is measured separately in eye-original-comparison.json.

original_eye_negative.meaning: Distance to nearest final skin, not to corresponding final aperture edge. Actual eye aperture outline is measured separately in eye-original-comparison.json.

original_eye_positive.meaning: Distance to nearest final skin, not to corresponding final aperture edge. Actual eye aperture outline is measured separately in eye-original-comparison.json.

region_definitions.eye_skin: Geodesic<=2mm from original31-edge main eye loops; original small8-edge lid slits are not main-eye loops
region_definitions.forehead: Explicit geometric bands; these were intentionally remodeled and are not asserted original.

interpretation: These are direct geometric differences, not a likeness score or corresponding-vertex motion. Earlier0-motion protection does not prove raw PMX agreement. Original low-poly face, mouth/eyelid closure, subdivision/fairing and print conversion can all contribute.
limitations: Original face material is an open face-and-ear patch; no original complete skull or removable cap exists for a whole-head comparison.
Median/p95 are sampling distributions; sampled maxima are not a certified continuous Hausdorff bound.
Nearest surface can slide tangentially; it can understate an aperture-edge shift. Eye outline is compared independently by same-depth projection.
Original PMX material, UV textures, eyelashes/eyebrows/eye whites/eyeballs and hair affect perceived likeness but are excluded from this face-skin geometry comparison.
No claim of exact source identity or unchanged facial sculpt is inferred from historical version-to-version locks.

nose_protrusion_extrema.definition: Minimum Y among source/final vertices in |X|<=5,13<=Z<=27,Y<-12; true coordinate extrema of each piecewise-linear mesh, not index correspondence. The original sharp low-poly nose tip and rounded PRINT extremum need not be the same anatomical point.

eye_aperture_original_comparison.warning: Original zero-thickness skin aperture versus final through-hole includes wall/eyeball-seat occlusion. It proves effective openings differ; it is not a pointwise rim displacement measure.

main_face_contours.definition: Intersection with Z=constant, only points Y<=-8mm retained to exclude posterior cranium/ear bulk; reported X extrema describe this explicitly clipped anterior-face section, not a whole-head or full cheek silhouette.

conclusion.summary_zh: 鼻口、下巴和主脸颊的表面大部分与原模型接近，但不是逐点原样。原始眼洞与当前有效通孔的轮廓和间距有可测差别；原鼻尖被圆顺。额头和太阳穴经过明确重塑，不能归入原始面雕完全一致。
